3544-how-he-lied-to-her-husband.title: How He Lied To Her Husband
3544-how-he-lied-to-her-husband.creator: George Bernard Shaw
3544-how-he-lied-to-her-husband.description: A book by George Bernard Shaw. self-restraint under the impression that they were upholding virtue instead of outraging it. They infected each other with their hysteria until they were for all practical purposes indecently mad. They finally forced the police to arrest Mr Daly and his company, and led the magistrate to express his loathing of the duty thus forced upon him of reading an unmentionable and abominable play.

5003-the-rover-boys-in-new-york-or-savin.title: The Rover Boys In New York Or Saving Their Father S Honor
5003-the-rover-boys-in-new-york-or-savin.creator: Arthur M. Winfield
5003-the-rover-boys-in-new-york-or-savin.description: A book by Arthur M. Winfield. trust the perusal of my works will do them good. Affectionately and sincerely yours,   Arthur M. CHAPTER I  THE BOYS AT BRILL   "Boys, what do you say to a trip in the Dartaway this afternoon?"  "Suits me, Sam," replied Tom Rover. "Providing the breeze doesn't get too strong," returned Dick Rover, as he put up his hand to feel the air. "Oh, I don't think it will blow too much," went on Sam Rover.

arxiv-2312-03191.title: Can we distinguish black holes with electric and magnetic charges from quasinormal modes? Preprint: YITP-23-158, WUCG-23-12
arxiv-2312-03191.creator: Antonio De Felice 1 and Shinji Tsujikawa 2
arxiv-2312-03191.description: Abstract We compute the quasinormal modes of static and spherically symmetric black holes (BHs) with electric and magnetic charges. For the electrically charged case, the dynamics of perturbations separates into the odd- and even-parity sectors with two coupled differential equations in each sector.

arxiv-2401-15216.title: Quantum-Assisted Adaptive Beamforming in UASs Network: Enhancing Airborne Communication via Collaborative UASs for NextG IoT
arxiv-2401-15216.creator: Sudhanshu Arya, and Ying Wang
arxiv-2401-15216.description: Abstract This paper introduces a novel quantum-based method for dynamic beamforming and re-forming in Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UASs), specifically addressing the critical challenges posed by the unavoidable hovering characteristics of UAVs. Hovering creates significant beam path distortions, impacting the reliability and quality of distributed beamforming in airborne networks.

arxiv-2501-16649.title: MFConvTr: Multi-Frequency Convolutional Transformer for Fetal Arrhythmia Detection in Non-Invasive fECG
arxiv-2501-16649.creator: Deva Satya Sriram Chintapenta ∗, Aman Verma ∗, Saikat Majumder
arxiv-2501-16649.description: Abstract NI-fECG have emerged as alternative for fetal arrhythmia monitoring. But due to multi-signal waveform they are tough to understand and due to highly varying and complex nature traditional fiducial methods cannot be applied. Further, it has also been observed that the fetal arrhythmia can be differentiated from the normal signals in both spectral and temporal scales.

arxiv-2512-09876.title: Homological Milnor-Witt modules and Chow-Witt groups over general bases
arxiv-2512-09876.creator: Frédéric Déglise, Niels Feld, Fangzhou Jin
arxiv-2512-09876.description: Abstract . We introduce a general theory of Milnor–Witt cycle modules over a base scheme S S , extending simultaneously Rost’s classical cycle modules and Feld’s Milnor-Witt theory over fields, and yielding a Borel-Moore type intersection theory with quadratic coefficients.

arxiv-2601-05912.title: Accounting for environmental awareness in wheat production through Life Cycle Assessment
arxiv-2601-05912.creator: Gianfranco GiulioniEdmondo Di Giuseppe, Arianna Di Paola
arxiv-2601-05912.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Gianfranco GiulioniEdmondo Di Giuseppe, Arianna Di Paola. This paper presents a modeling framework for simulating the decision-making processes of artificial farms populating an agent-based model for the Italian wheat production system. The decision process is based on a mathematical programming model with which farms (i.e., agents) decide the target yield (production per hectare) and the mix of inputs needed to obtain such production, namely 1) fertilizers, 2) herbicides, and 3) insecticides.

pmc-11454170.creator: Eduardo Mora, Aaron Bolduc, Ghada Elshimy
pmc-11454170.description: Disclosure: E. Mora: None. A. Bolduc, MD: None. G. Elshimy: None.Title: Pheochromocytoma Screening in a Patient With Neurofibromatosis Type I and Medication-Resistant Hypertension Background: Patients with neurofibromatosis type I (NF1) have a higher risk of pheochromocytoma and it may be missed if no screening done, thus placing the patient at risk of stroke and/or myocardial infarction.

pmc-11573754.title: Association of serum klotho with cognitive function among individuals with nonalcoholic fatty liver disease
pmc-11573754.creator: Feilong Wu, Jie Pan, Mingtao Chen, Xuye Lai, Yingying Gu, Lei Pei, Lili Yang
pmc-11573754.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionThis study investigated the potential link between serum klotho levels and cognitive function in patients with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD).Materials and MethodsUtilizing NHANES data from 2011 to 2014, the research included 356 eligible participants. NAFLD was identified with the United States Fatty Liver Index (US-FLI), and cognition was measured by various tests including the Animal Fluency Test (AFT), Digit Symbol Substitution Test (DSST), Immediate Recall Test (IRT), and Delayed Recall Test (DRT).

pmc-11682764.title: Possible relationship between pre-pregnancy maternal body mass index and offspring hippocampus: An experimental study in albino Wistar rat
pmc-11682764.creator: Zahraa A. Greash, Layla Omran Elmajdoub, Eman Fayad, Ali H. Abu Almaaty
pmc-11682764.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background:Cognitive impairment and attention deficit disorder have been on the rise among generations in recent times. A significant portion of the brain involved in learning and cognition is the hippocampus. Its development begins in utero till weaning.

pmc-12423034.title: The effect of hip manipulation on muscle strength, proprioception and motor tests of basketball players during training
pmc-12423034.creator: Rafał Studnicki, Zuzanna Patrzykąt, Adam Kawczyński
pmc-12423034.description: IntroductionThis study aimed to (i) investigate the effects of diagonal manual therapy on gluteus medius activation and (ii) examine its impact on quadriceps femoris activation, both critical for lower limb stability.MethodsNine male basketball players (mean age 23.8 ± 4.1 years) participated in a randomized crossover trial, with measurements taken before the intervention, immediately after, and following a training session.

pmc-13096714.title: High Prevalence of Non‐BRCA Pathogenic Variants and a Recurrent PALB2 Variant in an Argentine Hereditary Breast and Ovarian Cancer Cohort
pmc-13096714.creator: Claudia Alejandra Martin, Catalina Bono, Juliana Mandrile, Christine Susana Mercedes Kunst, Adriana Elizabeth Borello, Rodolfo Ávila, Florencia Celeste Salazar, Virginia Miretti, Florencia Pabletich, Verónica Andreoli, Danilo Guillermo Ceschin
pmc-13096714.description: Hereditary breast and ovarian cancer (HBOC) syndromes are strongly associated with germline pathogenic variants. While genetic testing historically focused on BRCA1/2, multigene panels have revealed clinically relevant variants in numerous non‐BRCA genes. However, data on the spectrum and prevalence of these variants remain limited in Argentina, particularly in regions with distinctive admixture patterns.

pmc-13617034.title: Urban health performance configurations in Chinese cities: longitudinal fsQCA, 2019–2024
pmc-13617034.creator: Donghai Ye, Juan Wang
pmc-13617034.description: IntroductionComposite city indices can rank urban health but rarely explain which conjunctions of public provision, economic capacity, resident action, and environmental conditions are sufficient, whether those conjunctions persist, or how cities move between them over time. This study addresses this configurational and temporal gap using longitudinal evidence from Chinese cities.

pmc-13682469.title: XPO1 coordinates human cytomegalovirus maturation by modulating genome encapsidation and secondary envelopment
pmc-13682469.creator: Jin-Peng Wu, Yue-Peng Zhou, Meng-Jie Mei, Yu-Ting Pan, Jin-Yan Sun, Wen-Bo Zeng, Han Cheng, Min-Hua Luo, Bo Yang
pmc-13682469.description: Human cytomegalovirus (HCMV) replication depends on tightly coordinated nuclear capsid assembly and cytoplasmic nucleocapsid maturation, yet host factors controlling these processes remain poorly defined. Here, we identify exportin 1 (XPO1) as a dual-phase regulator that coordinates HCMV maturation from nucleus to cytoplasm. XPO1 inhibition induces aberrant nuclear electron-dense speckles and accumulation of B-capsids.
